notes: GAAP audit. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p7); loan proceeds 1,228,783 are printed among revenues, so they are a receipt line (Loan Proceeds). Gross transfers from the fund columns (each fund prints only its net transfers): in General 266,511 + Golf 136,204, out Infrastructure 370,784 + Economic Development 88,702 + Other Governmental 5,000; total column net (61,771). Fund balance roll-forward 4,181,082 + 10,703,487 - 8,452,127 - 61,771 = 6,370,671 reconciles. Ending cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash and cash equivalents 5,853,676 (p5); certificates of deposit 349,738; county treasurer cash 27,420 separate; beginning cash not printed. Business-type from the proprietary funds statement Total column (p9); total expenses 5,811,153 equal the Statement of Activities (p2); 10,481,404 + 6,307,280 - 5,811,153 + 61,771 = 11,039,302 reconciles. Utility 'Other revenue' is counted in Charges for Services on the Statement of Activities (6,147,553). Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position, governmental and business-type columns (component unit excluded); totals from the Total column. General Fund detail from the department combining schedule (pp21-22); the General Fund budgetary comparison schedule (p14) is not recorded (less detailed, same fund). Street, Airport, Infrastructure, Economic Development and Golf detail from their budgetary comparison schedules (budget basis; amounts differ from the GAAP fund statement, recorded as printed). Nonmajor funds from the combining statement (p20). Utility funds have no budget schedules, so their detail is from the proprietary statement fund columns (p9). Read pages 1-22 of 22
